assessments.reasoning: IBM differentiates execution of ON from later execution of the action and makes dynamic scope subject to replacement and block termination. It distinguishes same-invocation replacement from stacking in a descendant.

limitations: REVERT, another ON statement or termination of the establishing block can end or override the association. Implicit SYSTEM actions, diagnostics, and the point of return from an ON-unit have separate rules.
